events.title: Shi Jingtang is enthroned as first emperor of the Later Jin
events.description: The Liao emperor Yelü Deguang enthroned Shi Jingtang, who had rebelled at Taiyuan against the Later Tang, as founding emperor of the Later Jin. In return Shi ceded the Sixteen Prefectures and called himself the son of the Liao emperor.

events.title: Skanderbeg takes Krujë with a forged letter from the sultan
events.description: Having deserted the Ottoman army, Skanderbeg arrived at Krujë and, using a forged letter from Sultan Murad II to its governor, became lord of the city. Its castle became his stronghold in twenty-five years of resistance to the Ottomans.

events.title: Lê Thánh Tông sets out by sea to attack Champa
events.description: Emperor Lê Thánh Tông of Đại Việt led a 100,000-strong naval expedition from Hóa Châu against Champa, in retaliation for Cham raids. In 1471 he captured Vijaya, the Cham capital, in a war widely seen as marking Champa's downfall.

events.title: Magellan's ships enter the Pacific
events.description: After 38 days navigating the strait at the tip of South America, Ferdinand Magellan's three remaining ships reached the open ocean. He named it the Pacific for its calm waters.
events.html: After 38 days navigating the strait at the tip of South America, Ferdinand Magellan's three remaining ships reached the open ocean. He named it the Pacific for its calm waters.

events.title: Royal forces defeat Covenanter insurgents at Rullion Green
events.description: At least 3,000 men of the Scots Army under Tam Dalyell of the Binns defeated about 900 Covenanter insurgents led by James Wallace of Auchens at Rullion Green. The Covenanters, Scottish Presbyterians, were persecuted after the Restoration.

events.title: Arthur Griffith launches Sinn Féin's policy
events.description: At a convention in Dublin, Arthur Griffith set out the Sinn Féin policy, meaning 'we ourselves', of Irish self-reliance and a separate Irish parliament. The movement later became central to the struggle for independence.

events.title: Albania declares independence
events.description: In Vlorë, Ismail Qemali raised the Albanian flag and proclaimed independence from the Ottoman Empire during the First Balkan War. The great powers recognised the new state the following year.

events.title: Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin meet in Tehran
events.description: The 'Big Three' met together for the first time at the Tehran Conference. They committed to a cross-Channel invasion of France in 1944 and discussed the shape of post-war Europe.
